intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Ajeenkya DY Patil University vs Symbiosis Institute of Design is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the Bachelor Of Design classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Ajeenkya DY Patil University vs Symbiosis Institute of Design for Bachelor Of Design: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Ajeenkya DY Patil University if you want a 2020 flagship package record of ₹7 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹3.5 lakh, in a private Bachelor Of Design setting at Pune.
Choose Symbiosis Institute of Design if you want a recorded fee of ₹8.6 lakh, and an admission route through SET, in a private Bachelor Of Design setting at Pune.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹3.5 lakh as a tuition figure for Bachelor of Product Design Product Design at Ajeenkya DY Patil University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹8.6 lakh as a tuition figure for B.Design Communication Design at Symbiosis Institute of Design. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Ajeenkya DY Patil University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹7 LPA and a highest package of ₹14 LPA on Bachelor of Product Design Product Design. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Symbiosis Institute of Design here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Ajeenkya DY Patil University is listed on our records with UCEED as an admission route for this Bachelor Of Design comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.

Symbiosis Institute of Design is listed on our records with SET as an admission route for this Bachelor Of Design comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, Ajeenkya DY Patil University is the clearer record here, because Symbiosis Institute of Design has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.

Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Symbiosis Institute of Design's recorded ₹8.6 lakh or Ajeenkya DY Patil University's ₹3.5 lakh fits your budget for this Bachelor Of Design.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Ajeenkya DY Patil University or Symbiosis Institute of Design?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Ajeenkya DY Patil University and Symbiosis Institute of Design differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of Bachelor Of Design classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Ajeenkya DY Patil University vs Symbiosis Institute of Design?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹3.5 lakh for Ajeenkya DY Patil University on Bachelor of Product Design Product Design; our records list ₹8.6 lakh for Symbiosis Institute of Design on B.Design Communication Design. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Ajeenkya DY Patil University and Symbiosis Institute of Design?
faqs.answer: Ajeenkya DY Patil University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹7 LPA and a highest package of ₹14 LPA on Bachelor of Product Design Product Design. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Ajeenkya DY Patil University and Symbiosis Institute of Design accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list UCEED for Ajeenkya DY Patil University, and SET for Symbiosis Institute of Design. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Ajeenkya DY Patil University and Symbiosis Institute of Design in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Pune, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
